proposal.diagnosis: The issue lies in the `next_state` function where incorrect state transitions occur when handling certain characters, particularly within comments. The faulty line (463) improperly calculates the next DFA state, leading to all subsequent tokens being classified as errors instead of correctly identifying valid tokens or skipping comments.

causal_chain: The `next_state` function at line 463 mishandles transitions when `base[state] - ch < 0`, causing incorrect state progression.
This leads to improper token classification, especially for characters following a comment delimiter (`;`).
As a result, all tokens after an unclosed comment are incorrectly marked as errors.
